answer: Require each new identity to lock a stake that is released only after its work passes a random audit: the network splits the stake like light through a prism, holding one part as a bond and one part as a fee, and every marble of reputation earned is tied to that locked stake. If an audit finds copied or fake work, the whole stake is slashed and the identity winds down in a spiral of escalating penalties, so running a hundred fake agents costs a hundred real stakes while honest agents pay only once.
